meta.name: azure-cloud-architect
meta.description: Design Azure architectures for startups and enterprises. Use when asked to design Azure infrastructure, create Bicep/ARM templates, optimize Azure costs, set up Azure DevOps pipelines, or migrate to Azure. Covers AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, and cost optimization.

copy.tagline: 设计并部署Azure云架构，优化成本与迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为初创或企业设计Azure基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Design and deploy Azure cloud architectures, optimize costs and migration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing Azure infrastructure for startups or enterprises

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按六步流程设计 Azure 云架构:收集需求,推荐服务组合(如 App Service、AKS),生成 Bicep 模板,给出成本优化和 CI/CD 配置建议,并做安全审查。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计 Azure 基础设施、生成 Bicep/ARM 模板,或优化 Azure 成本时触发;也会在配置 Azure DevOps 管道、迁移到 Azure 等场景接管。

say.text: 帮我的 SaaS 平台设计 Azure 微服务架构,预计 5 万用户。
say.note: 会推荐服务栈并给出估算成本。

say.text: 用 Bicep 生成 Web 应用模板,预算每月 500 美元。
say.note: 会输出可部署的 Bicep 文件。

say.text: 分析这份 Azure 资源清单,找省钱点。
say.note: 会列出优先级的优化建议。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude follows a six-step workflow for Azure architectures: gather requirements, recommend a service stack (e.g., App Service), generate Bicep templates, suggest cost optimization and CI/CD config, and do a security review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to design Azure infrastructure, create Bicep/ARM templates, or optimize Azure costs; also takes over for Azure DevOps pipeline setup and Azure migration scenarios.

say_en.text: Design an Azure microservices architecture for a SaaS platform with 50k users.
say_en.note: Recommends a service stack and cost estimate.

say_en.text: Generate a Bicep template for a web app with a $500 monthly budget.
Analyze this Azure resource list for cost savings.
